decisions.subject: Production pipeline for a 30s news/viral short

options_considered.label: animated-explainer
options_considered.reason: Generated short from researched news; research → proposal → kinetic compose.

options_considered.label: cinematic
options_considered.reason: Wrong grammar for a mute-first news slam.

decisions.reason: User asked for a 30s viral video about news / YouTube / TikTok. Explainer + short-form.md.

decisions.subject: Which live story is the A-story

options_considered.label: The $26 loophole (ghost creators)
options_considered.reason: This week's YouTube + TikTok news: 45M views, $26 actors, 20-channel takedown, detector bypass.

options_considered.label: Jisoo CLICK same-day MV
options_considered.reason: 1.7M views in four hours, real today.
options_considered.rejected_because: Fandom drop, not news about the platforms.

decisions.reason: Matches 'in the news' AND 'viral on YouTube and TikTok' without restaging the political attack videos.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime for the 9:16 short

options_considered.label: Remotion (React scene stack)
options_considered.reason: Would own karaoke captions if installed. Explainer stock comps are 16:9.
options_considered.rejected_because: runtime not available on this machine

options_considered.label: HyperFrames (HTML/CSS/GSAP)
options_considered.reason: Best kinetic type for this brief.
options_considered.rejected_because: runtime not available on this machine

options_considered.label: FFmpeg Ken Burns + ASS + generated bed
options_considered.reason: ffmpeg 6.1.1 is present. Can ship 1080x1920 / 30s / burned captions with no keys.

decisions.reason: Both Remotion and HyperFrames were evaluated. Neither is on this machine. ffmpeg locked at proposal.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: Captions + music bed
options_considered.reason: 85% watch muted; honest given no TTS.

decisions.reason: No TTS on this machine. Captions are the voice.

decisions.subject: Background music

options_considered.label: 108 BPM dark news bed
options_considered.reason: Starts at frame 0, slams on cuts.

decisions.reason: Need immediate bed; cannot download stock.
